description: Read today's free-score balance. Prefer this over score_spend when you are not judging a specific payment, including before a batch or after a 402: it does not consume a score, returns no verdict, and is never billed. Do not use it to approve or block a spend. Pass api_key for that sg_live_ key (tier free, 1,000/UTC day); omit it for this client's anonymous bucket (tier anonymous, 100/UTC day). An unrecognized or non-sg_live_ key returns invalid_api_key and does not fall back. Returns subject (anonymous|api_key|bundle), key_id, key_prefix, tier (anonymous|free|bundle), daily_limit, used_today, remaining_today, paid_today, price_usd, price_atomic, asset (USDC), network, resets_at (next UTC midnight), and paid_configured. Mint a higher cap with get_api_key.

api_key.description: Optional sg_live_ key to read. Omit for the anonymous bucket. Does not mint a key. An unrecognized key returns invalid_api_key.
